dedupe_keys.name: sim volatile netlogo agent based model of the adoption of a volatile fatty acid platform by waste treatment plants

description: SIM-VOLATILE is a technology adoption model for the waste-treatment industry, written in NetLogo by Siavash Farahbakhsh and peer reviewed in the CoMSES library in 2022. It asks what stops waste-treatment plants from adopting an emerging circular technology, the Volatile Fatty Acid Platform, which would let them turn organic waste into high-value products instead of only producing biogas. Three adoption and investment scenarios are modelled, for polyhydroxyalkanoates, single-cell oils and polyunsaturated fatty acids, and the associated paper by Farahbakhsh and co-authors reports drivers and barriers. Version 1.0.0 is available as a free download from CoMSES under a CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 licence, with a DOI. Caveats: the licence forbids modified versions, and the technology was still at the optimisation stage when modelled. Coverage is general. Simulation uses: projecting changes in treatment capacity and outputs of the organic waste system. Related records: the biodigestion network model (model-comses-circular-business-model-biodigestion-network) covers the viability of the incumbent biogas route.
inputs: Investment scenarios for PHA, single-cell oils and PUFA products
name: SIM-VOLATILE: NetLogo agent-based model of the adoption of a volatile fatty acid platform by waste-treatment plants
outputs: Adoption of the volatile fatty acid platform over time
